Klasse Box<A>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Box<A>
Typparameter:
A - the type of the contained value
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Supplier<A>, Appliable<Box.µ,A>, Bindable<Box.µ,A>, Copyable<Box<A>>, Mappable<Box.µ,A>, Monadic<Box.µ,A>, Transmogrifyable<Box<A>>, Unwindable<Box<A>>, Value<A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Box.µ,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Box.µ>
public class Box<A> extends Object implements Copyable<Box<A>>, Transmogrifyable<Box<A>>, Unwindable<Box<A>>, Value<A>, Monadic<Box.µ,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Box.µ,A>

A lightweight container that holds a value lazily using a Supplier.

Box implements common algebraic abstractions such as Monadic, Value, Transmogrifyable, Unwindable, and Copyable.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • zip

      public <B,C> @NonNull Box<C> zip(@NonNull Box<B> other, @NonNull BiFunction<? super A, ? super B, ? extends C> combiner)

      Combines this Box with another Box using the given combiner function.

      Laziness: The combiner function is not invoked until the value of the resulting Box is evaluated.

      Typparameter:
      B - the other value type
      C - the result type
      Parameter:
      other - the other Box; must not be null
      combiner - the combining function; must not be null and must not return null
      Gibt zurück:
      a new Box containing the combined value
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if other or combiner is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0
